text:
Ava (PM): FYI Sierra Systems just confirmed they want a Private deployment with two must-have items for contract signing: VPC peering + 12mo audit log retention. They need a firm delivery date for billing/legal.
Diego (AE): They also reiterated dedicated capacity SLA (p99 latency) and model pinning for compliance. Legal needs dates by EOD Friday.
Samir (Eng): Quick clarifying q: by "model pinning" do they mean immutable model versioning in the control plane (no automatic rollouts) or a custom sandboxed model instance?
Ava (PM): Immutable model versioning in control plane + ability to roll back only via API. No custom model binaries.
Priya (CS): They’ll also need SOC2-aligned evidence for data residency and a signed DPA. I can surface required docs but we should account time for legal review.
Luca (Infra): For VPC peering + 12mo logs: Peering is straightforward, ~2 sprints (2w) infra work for routing + hardened ingress. Logs: retention + storage tiering is ~1 sprint (1w) plus config UI. Dedicated capacity SLA depends on Dedicated backlog; if we allocate an express slot we can target provisioning in 3 weeks.
Samir (Eng): Engineering estimates: model pinning (control plane flag + API) = 4 dev-days + 1 day e2e tests. If we bundle with rollout guard rails and canary opt-out, add another 3 dev-days. Total ~11 dev-days.
Ava (PM): Can we map to calendar dates? Contract kickoff earliest next Mon (1769600000). If we start then: model pinning -> finish by 1769680000; VPC peering infra -> finish by 1769760000; logs -> 1769720000; Dedicated capacity staging -> 1769840000. These are optimistic.
Diego (AE): Client wants a single committed delivery date for signing. They prefer mid-quarter. Can we give them a consolidated ship date for the three must-haves?
Luca (Infra): Conservative consolidated date accounting for testing + legal = 1769840000 (approx 3 weeks after kickoff). If legal slows us, add 1 week buffer -> 1769900000.
Priya (CS): Note: onboarding + customer acceptance testing (UAT) typically takes 5 business days. Add that after infra finish. So consolidated target should be infra finish + 1 week.
Samir (Eng): We're fine with the conservative dates, but we need a comms plan for model-compatibility and fallback behavior. I’ll draft acceptance criteria: 
```
- Model pinning: API flag `pin_model_version=true` persists across deployments; rollback only via `unpin` API.
- VPC peering: bi-directional routes, healthcheck across peered subnets, documented runbook.
- Audit logs: immutable export to S3-compatible bucket, 12mo retention policy configurable per-tenant, encryption at rest.
- SLA: P99 latency target validated on 95th percentile workload during staging.
```
Ava (PM): Good. Action items: 1) Samir + Luca to finalize scoping doc by 1769520000, 2) Priya to prepare DPA checklist and compliance ask by 1769530000, 3) Diego to push client to agree to target 1769840000 or fallback 1769900000 by EOD Friday.
Diego (AE): I'll get commitment from Sierra by EOD. Will ping legal separately.
OpsBot: Deployment ticket #INC-5491 created for "Sierra Systems - Private deployment onboarding" assigned to eng-infra.
Ava (PM): Thanks — please keep updates in this thread. If legal pushes for earlier dates we’ll re-evaluate scope (e.g., deliver pinning + peering first, logs in phase 2). :thumbsup:
